about: Each building kind's windows (docs/v3/design.html#indoor-mode; engine/world/windows.mjs): on a room's outer wall, a window every `every` cells of 2 m (an offset seeded by the room), between `sill` and `head` metres from its floor; `balcony` the chance an upper-floor room's first window is a balcony door (to `doorHead`); `storefront` makes a ground-floor room's outer wall glass (between storefrontSill and storefrontHead). `every` 0: no windows. By the engine's role of the lot (roles) or a named building's use (uses); `default` under both. Read through the settings schema as the table models.windows: a universe or a book may change it.
